selection: all five excluded together, including identical sequences; training-only inner CV

config.PP_PR_fullcomplex_cohort: same identities as PP_complete, feature blocks explicitly distinguished
config.screening: Every available representation and requested retention at EVERY feasible threshold; exact full-entry dual linear reference. Equivalent clamped retention sizes deduplicated per training split but candidate IDs retained.
config.refinement_eligibility: LR elasticnet/RBF/RF/ET only <=5000 transformed dimensions; LDA only <=100; high-dimensional full models use exact kernel embedding for Ridge/linear SVM and LR L2
config.decision_boundary: native classifier margin boundary or native probability 0.5; no tuning, no arbitrary softmax
config.inner: 3-fold stratified grouped identity for LOCO. Three purged position partitions with up to20 deterministic feasibility attempts for LORPO/JOINT/FULL, no identity fallback in strict primary.
config.missing_coordinates: training-fitted complete-coordinate filter, never whole-block imputation. Missing selected test coordinates => not_estimable. Mutation-relative excluded pairs use training-mean neutral centering with eligibility mask; never called zero contact.
config.variance: rank corresponding pair CP entries before scaling; deterministic index tie break; selected counts clamped after train invalid/constant removal; thresholds do not inspect held-out values
config.block_scaling: train mean/std per entry then divide by sqrt(selected count per block); combines equal expected block energy
config.PCA: training-only Gram eigendecomposition of standardized inputs; rank capped; all-entry dual reference retains all nonzero training directions and is NOT truncated PCA
config.references: PR shared legacy endpoint WT; PP shared legacy architecture WT432 core only; delta missing beyond432, never zero. RR delta unavailable.
config.matched_ablation: primary fold threshold fixed; per comparator train-only selection among its screened configurations at that threshold; summary/TRM/position/region controls tune Ridge alpha .1/1/10 on identical inner/outer splits
config.permutation: primary only, held-out groups >=3, block permutation 3 fixed repeats; never one-sample permutation
config.uncertain_zero: flags retained; paired descriptive sensitivity excludes uncertainty affected records in reported subset, no removal to optimize primary scores
config.raw_vs_delta: report coverage/core differences, raw and delta same support comparisons include matching PP core coverage
